changelog.description: Fixed update information remaining cached after an ElectroWrite upgrade by detecting when the installed app version has changed, even within the 30-minute cache window.
Prevented previously downloaded APKs for the installed version or older releases from being offered for installation again.
Added installed-version checks before update downloads and installations, including another validation after acquiring the update-file coordination lock.
Prevented completed foreground-service download records for already installed or older versions from restoring outdated 'ready to install' messages.
Improved post-upgrade changelog filtering by comparing releases against the actual currently installed ElectroWrite version rather than a cached update-check result.
Reset the What's New heading when there are no newer changelog entries.
Improved the Major Bug Fixed changelog icon for Android 6.0/6.0.1 (API 23) and earlier by using a legacy-compatible hammer emoji.
Added clearer Android compatibility messages for devices below the minimum requirement, within the declared target range, and newer than the release's target API.
Added a future-proof compatibility notice for Android versions newer than the release's target, without automatically treating them as incompatible.
Updated the Android compile SDK to 36.1 while retaining Android 5.0 (API 21) as the minimum requirement and Android 16 (API 36) as the target SDK.
Added Android 17 (API 37) to runtime compatibility testing; Android 17 is not the app's target SDK.
Raised the Android application version code to 28 for correct upgrades from previously published builds.
Added Find & Replace to the document editor with Find Next, Replace, and Replace All commands.
Improved text searching with case-insensitive matching, wraparound to the beginning of the document, and selection-aware Find Next behavior.
Integrated Replace and Replace All with document modification tracking and Undo/Redo history.
Added Find & Replace feedback for unmatched searches and the number of occurrences replaced.
Added a foreground-service-based APK downloader that can continue downloading when the Update screen is closed or the Activity is recreated.
Added a persistent downloaded-update record containing the APK path, version, file size, source URL, and download completion state.
Added restoration of completed download information after restarting ElectroWrite.
Added a dedicated in-memory download state store to synchronize the foreground service with the Update interface.
Added live download progress reporting, including transferred bytes, total bytes when available, and percentage.
Added HTTP Range support to resume interrupted APK downloads instead of restarting from the beginning when the server supports resuming.
Added ETag-based resume validation to help detect changed remote APK files.
Added resumable-download metadata stored alongside partial downloads.
Improved download completion checks using transferred-byte totals and file-size validation.
Added automatic retries for recoverable download failures, with progressively longer delays.
Added retry-attempt tracking and countdown messages for interrupted downloads.
Improved retry handling so users can see when the next download attempt will begin.
Added cancellation support for foreground downloads, including cancellation from the notification.
Improved cancellation handling to prevent late progress callbacks from restoring an active download state.
Improved coordination between download lifecycle events, notifications, and Activity state changes.
Improved download error reporting for network interruptions, failures, and cancellations.
Added a dedicated Android notification channel for update downloads on Android 8.0 and newer.
Added foreground notifications showing the current update-download status.
Added notification actions to open the Update screen and cancel an active download.
Added separate notifications for completed, failed, and cancelled downloads.
Added dynamic notification titles for preparing, downloading, retrying, cancelling, completed, failed, and cancelled states.
Added expanded notification details showing the ElectroWrite version and download progress.
Reduced unnecessary notification refreshes by throttling update-progress notifications.
Added notification behavior that adapts to Android versions with and without notification channels.
Added animated download-progress feedback in the ElectroWrite Update interface.
Added a dedicated retry animation when a download is interrupted and waiting to resume.
Added one-time failure animation feedback for unsuccessful downloads.
Added one-time cancellation animation feedback for intentionally cancelled downloads.
Added completion animation feedback when a foreground-service download finishes.
Added a dedicated Verifying... state in the Update interface and foreground download notification while the APK SHA-256 checksum is checked.
Added a verified-download completion message confirming that SHA-256 verification passed and the APK is ready for installation.
Improved animation lifecycle handling to avoid replaying old completion, failure, or cancellation animations.
Improved Update screen restoration when returning from a notification or recreating the Activity.
Added update-cache scanning and storage-size diagnostics for APK files in the private updates directory.
Added cache-file classification for protected files, possible obsolete APKs, partial downloads, and unknown files.
Added read-only cleanup previews showing potential deletion candidates and recoverable storage.
Added a cache-cleanup plan and result model for future controlled cleanup operations.
Added safeguards to preserve the saved completed APK and active download paths during cache-cleanup planning.
Added managed-directory, filename, and file-attribute checks to the cache-cleanup execution foundation.
Kept automatic update-cache deletion disabled while download coordination and deletion authorization are being finalized.
Added an update-file coordination helper for future exclusive access to update files.
Added a SHA-256 integrity verification utility that hashes APK files without loading the entire file into memory.
Added SHA-256 checksum format validation and constant-time digest comparison.
Added a per-release sha256 field to the update manifest model.
Added SHA-256 metadata validation before starting new foreground-service downloads.
Added expected-checksum transfer from the Update screen to the foreground download task.
Completed automatic post-download SHA-256 integrity verification and blocked installation until the downloaded APK passes validation.
Rejected legacy or unverified saved-download records when restoring the Update screen, preventing an untrusted APK from being shown as ready to install.
Maintained the updater’s Android 5.0 (API 21) minimum compatibility target while adding background download features.
Added live APK download-speed and estimated-time-remaining information to the Update screen.
Added another SHA-256 integrity check before handing a downloaded APK to Android for installation.
Improved validation of downloaded APKs against the selected release version, source URL, and expected checksum.
Added application-scoped HTTPS certificate compatibility for Android 5.0 and 5.1 using verified Sectigo Root E46 and ISRG Root X1 certificates.
Added GitHub release-asset download certificate compatibility for Android 6.0 Marshmallow (API 23).
Maintained HTTPS certificate verification and automatic GitHub download redirects without bypassing TLS security.
Improved support for GitHub Release APK download redirects to release-assets.githubusercontent.com on legacy Android devices.
Fixed APK download certificate verification errors that prevented updates on supported Android 5.0, 5.1, and 6.0 devices.
Added installation of verified downloaded APK updates directly from the ElectroWrite Update screen.
Added safeguards to prevent installation while an APK download is still active.
Added an unsaved-document warning before opening the Android update installer.
Added a guided Android install-permission prompt on Android versions that require per-app permission for APK installation.
Added a file-based installation handoff specifically for Android 5.0 Lollipop (API 21).
Added SHA-256 verification and safe reuse of public Downloads APK copies used by the Android 5.0 installer.
Added PackageInstaller session-based installation handoff for Android 5.1 through 6.0 (API 22–23).
Preserved the FileProvider-based APK installation handoff on Android 7.0 and newer.
Added private installer-staging copies so Android can install a verified APK without depending on the original download file remaining unchanged.
Added checksum-based validation of staged installer APKs and their installation metadata.
Improved installation preparation by reusing verified staged APK copies instead of repeatedly copying large files.
Avoided redundant downloads when the same release APK is already stored and passes the existing verified-download checks.
Added persistent installation-attempt records with target version, previously installed version, and unique handoff identifiers.
Added separate installation-attempt history so earlier attempts remain available when staged APK metadata is reused.
Protected completed installation-history outcomes from stale snapshot overwrites and added guarded version-observation updates.
Added Android PackageInstaller result tracking for pending user action, successful installs, cancelled installs, and failures on supported legacy versions.
Matched Android installer callbacks to unique installation attempt IDs so delayed results cannot overwrite a newer attempt.
Added installation-outcome reconciliation that checks the installed version after ElectroWrite resumes or restarts.
Improved cancelled-installation handling so a rejected installation does not appear as a successful update.
Added read-only installation-outcome, installation-history, and recovery diagnostics in Logcat.
Added installation-staging storage and retention previews to report protected files and possible future cleanup candidates.
Added protections for staged APKs referenced by installer handoffs or historical installation attempts.
Added interrupted-write detection for temporary installation metadata and history files; cleanup eligibility is suspended when unfinished writes are found.
Added safeguards that suspend staged-APK cleanup when installation history is invalid or uncertain.
Added historical-reference inspection to prevent cleanup previews from treating referenced APKs as disposable.
Improved read-only cleanup diagnostics with protected-file counts, potential storage savings, and human-readable safety status.
Kept automatic deletion of downloaded, staged, and Android 5.0 public APK copies disabled until a complete deletion policy is validated.
Added Android 5.0 public APK storage diagnostics to support future safe cleanup decisions.
Added an immediate Preparing Installation... button state while ElectroWrite verifies and prepares an APK.
Added Installation in Progress... and Installation Complete ✓ button states during Android installer handoff and recorded success.
Prevented duplicate installation requests by disabling Install Update during preparation and installer handoff.
Restored Install Update availability after a matching Android 5.1–6.0 installer attempt reports cancellation or failure.
Kept Install Update disabled while Android's installation outcome remains unconfirmed.
Validated update checks, APK downloads, and installer handoffs on Android 5.0/5.1 emulators, legacy Galaxy S4/S5 devices, and an Android 10 device.

On Android 5.1–6.0, leaving the installer without a recorded final result may leave Install Update showing Installation in Progress... until ElectroWrite is restarted. This prevents duplicate installer requests while the result is uncertain.
Fixed the Android 5.0 installer-unavailable error by introducing an API 21-compatible APK installation handoff.
Improved installation error messages for missing APK files, mismatched release information, failed SHA-256 verification, and unexpected file changes.
Preserved verified downloaded APKs after cancelled installations so users can retry without downloading the same update again.
Restored installer-button availability when returning from Android 5.0 and Android 7.0+ non-session installer handoffs.
Added an Ahead of Channel update state for installations newer than the latest version available in the active update channel.
Added dedicated visual feedback for the Ahead of Channel state, including violet status styling, icon glow, and a special multi-stage result animation.
Improved update-status messages to clearly identify when the installed ElectroWrite version is newer than the latest version in its update channel.
Improved Update button behavior so its state and label respond consistently to the current update result.
Improved update action handling by centralizing Update button state management.
Improved updater state handling for checking, available, unavailable, up-to-date, and ahead-of-channel results.
Added Last Checked information to the About ElectroWrite and ElectroWrite Update interfaces.
Improved Last Checked information with Today, Yesterday, and dated timestamp formatting.
Fixed Ahead of Channel detection for development builds that are newer than every release currently listed in the update manifest.
Improved update channel selection so unlisted development builds can fall back to the Beta channel for update evaluation.
Improved updater diagnostics when an update channel does not contain valid latest-version information.
Added Android-version-aware Ahead of Channel status icons, using a legacy-compatible symbol on older Android versions that do not reliably support the newer test-tube emoji.
Improved Ahead of Channel presentation on legacy Android devices, including Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow.
Redesigned the About ElectroWrite interface with a more polished card-based layout.
Added a dedicated Application Information card to the About screen for ElectroWrite product, platform, developer, and brand information.
Redesigned the About screen's Update Status section with a dedicated status card and primary Check for Updates action.
Added a staggered entrance animation to the About ElectroWrite interface.
Redesigned the ElectroWrite Update interface with dedicated Update Status, Version Information, Android Compatibility, and What's New cards.
Added dynamic update-status card colors for checking, successful, available, recommended, compatibility-warning, and failed update states.
Added a staggered entrance animation to the ElectroWrite Update interface.
Added animated result feedback to updater information cards when an update check completes.
Improved update-result transitions so update information, status colors, icon glows, and card animations respond together.
Improved update animation stability by coordinating entrance and result animations during fast update checks.
Improved update-screen animation safety so delayed result animations do not continue after leaving the Update interface.
Refined ElectroWrite buttons, cards, spacing, typography, and information hierarchy across the About and Update interfaces.
Maintained the redesigned About and Update interfaces using Android-compatible UI and animation behavior for supported legacy Android devices.
Improved ElectroWrite icon glow visibility across the About and Update interfaces.
Increased update-status glow intensity for clearer visual feedback on light backgrounds.
Expanded the icon glow area to create a larger and more noticeable visual halo.
Improved the update-checking pulse with a stronger and more visible glow animation.
Improved the About ElectroWrite entrance glow while preserving its calmer visual appearance.
Added animated visual feedback to the ElectroWrite Update interface.
Added a pulsing glow animation around the ElectroWrite icon while checking for updates.
Added state-colored update glows for successful, available, recommended, warning, and failed update-check results.
Added a polished result animation when an update check finishes.
Added an animated ElectroWrite icon entrance to the About ElectroWrite screen.
Improved update-check animation transitions so checking animations cleanly transition into result animations.
Added a shared update-status display system for consistent update information across ElectroWrite.
Improved the About ElectroWrite screen with a dedicated Check for Updates button.
Improved the About screen so it displays the latest known update status using the same status information as the ElectroWrite Update screen.
Improved update checking so checking, success, compatibility, and failure states are stored consistently.
Fixed update-check failure handling so returned update-service errors are stored and displayed correctly.
Updated the About ElectroWrite description and default update-status presentation.
Improved the cumulative What's New system with clearer release information and update counts.
Improved update channel display names with consistent capitalization, including Pre-Alpha.
Added status icons and emojis throughout the ElectroWrite Update interface.
Added category icons to changelog sections for faster visual identification.
Added support for Major Bug Fixed, Bug Fixed, Performance, UI/UX, Accessibility, and additional changelog categories.
Release dates are now displayed in a more readable long-date format.
Cumulative changelog results are now limited to the latest version declared by the active update channel.
Added the ElectroWrite Update System.
Added online update information and changelog support.
Added support for update channels: Release, Beta, Alpha, and Pre-Alpha.
Added cumulative What's New support for displaying changelogs from missed updates.
Added Android compatibility information for minimum, recommended, and target Android versions.
Added classic Android version codenames to compatibility information for supported legacy Android releases.
Changed update manifest fetching to use the GitHub REST API for improved compatibility with older Android devices.
Fixed update manifest fetching on Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow devices affected by certificate trust errors with the previous GitHub Raw endpoint.
Update checks continue to require valid HTTPS certificate verification without bypassing certificate security.
Improved update connection error handling with user-friendly network, timeout, update-data, and secure-connection messages.
Improved update diagnostics by separating user-facing error messages from technical error details.
Updated the About screen to report the current update-system status.
Update information can now describe Android compatibility and recommended app versions.
Added Android x86 and x86-64 architecture support.
Expanded CPU architecture compatibility across ARM32, ARM64, x86, and x86-64.
Added support for Android 5.0 and Android 5.1 Lollipop (API levels 21 and 22).
Unified command availability so toolbar and overflow-menu actions stay in sync.
Added live cursor line and column tracking.
Added New, Open, and Save commands to the overflow menu.
Improved the overflow menu with organized dividers and Android-version-aware behavior.
Improved editor cursor tracking reliability.
Added Save As support.
Expanded the status bar with character count, cursor line and column, and file format information.
Document status information now updates as you edit.
Updated legacy Android app icons to the official ElectroWrite design.
Added the official ElectroWrite design to adaptive app icons on newer Android versions.
Added the About ElectroWrite screen.
Added the application overflow menu.
Added an Android-compatible ElectroWrite icon for the About screen.
Added the first official ElectroWrite application icons.
Added Open and Save support for text documents.
Updated the Android app name to ElectroWrite.
Added an unsaved-changes warning before leaving or replacing a modified document.
ElectroWrite now recognizes when document content returns to its last saved state.
Added Undo and Redo support.
Toolbar buttons now automatically enable or disable when their commands are available.
Added the main document toolbar.
Added live word counting to the document status bar.
Added the first working editor commands and toolbar controls.
Improved layout detection and initialization reliability.
Added a more reliable root layout for the main editor.
Improved modern Android system-bar and screen-inset handling.
Simplified the editor layout for better reliability.
Improved system-bar handling across different Android versions.
Improved protection against ElectroWrite content overlapping Android system bars.
Refined the ElectroWrite interface and Android status bar appearance.
Added the first visual styling system for ElectroWrite.
Added the first document editor layout.
Established the app structure for activities and document data.
Added the foundation for tracking the current document and its state.
Introduced the first Android version of ElectroWrite.
Added the initial ElectroWrite app identity and product information.
